catalogue.text: DEV CATALOGUE: built by ui/story/dev/make-dev-catalogue.mjs from committed files only; ENGINE's sim.scenarios writes story/index.json

why.text: Prices peaked at $566.42/MWh at 21:00, then fell to $55.42 at 22:00
why.label: REAL

why.text: ERCOT set its all-time demand record this day: 91,134 MW
why.label: REAL
why.cite: ERCOT all-time peak demand record, set 2026-07-22 (ERCOT all-time records page; docs/research-report.md:330)

why.label: REAL
why.cite: ERCOT RTM SPP LZ_NORTH 15-min (data/ercot/lz_north_2026.csv); the maximum 15-min price of 2026-08 in the file

why.text: A flat, cheap evening: the highest price was $34.23/MWh
why.label: REAL

why.text: ERCOT dispatches one number per zone and does not check feeders (REAL). The naive branch splits that number with no feeder check, all at once at the onset (ASSUMPTION: Base's real split is not public; §12 Q5).
why.label: ASSUMPTION

why.text: Home 0222 (behind D) goes silent after its 22:15 command (+19.0 kW); C runs hot: Home 0427 plugs in a Level 2 EV, +7.2 kW for 60 min (ASSUMPTION); our controller stalls for 8 min (longer than the 300 s command TTL)
why.label: ASSUMPTION
REAL
why.cite: CORE_POWER_KW: Base Core '(20 kW / 39.2 kWh)': https://www.basepowercompany.com/utilities; CORE_USABLE_KWH: 39.2 kWh nameplate; usable unpublished (four_home_constants.py)
